page.layout: One column of running text; running head at the top with page number at the upper right; catchword "pri-" printed at the lower right below the last line, with signature "C" at the centre foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: seu Papæ qui se venditat Episcopum
Par utilitas ex ruina potestatis Ec-
ad Episcopum, nec ad synodum, sed
larem, nec ordinatio erit actus aut
nis Divinæ, & oratio ad Deum, ut be-
Ecclesia, in qua electione non opus
est potestate Ecclesiastica, sed eâ quæ
est de jure naturali divino communi
testatis illius productio, sed mera de-
nolit ulterius uti ministerio hujus aut
illius, Nam injusta est illa occupatio,

page.notes: The text is set in a single column with a few small marks in the margins (dots and strokes) that are not printed words. The "C" under the text is a signature and the "pri-" at the lower right is a catchword. Some letters are faint due to the age of the paper, notably in "testificatio" and "depositio", but they were readable. The word "Societati" and "ministerio" are printed as shown.
